The client code still imports javax.mvc.Models, causing the symbol not found error at the field declaration. To adapt to the new API, we only need to update the import to jakarta.mvc.Models. No other code changes are required since the type name remains Models and the usage via @Inject models.put(...) should remain compatible. This minimal change ensures compilation without altering method signatures or behavior.
